title: Dr. Amethyst’s Reinforcement Homework — Brainwashing Triggers
description:
You didn’t think Dr. Amethyst’s experiment ended behind that locked door, did you?

There’s a follow-up assignment—and I’ve reserved this part of September’s story for My Amethyst Collective VIP members. 💜

Dr. Amethyst’s Reinforcement Homework — Brainwashing Triggers is your next appointment: a 16½-minute companion to the locked-door experience, ready for you to explore.

On Patreon, this release is available exclusively to Amethyst Collective VIP members and above. And My VIPs have more goodies coming before September is over. I’m keeping a few details to Myself for now… you’ll discover them as the month unfolds.
author: Mistress Amethyst
